name: Superman
summary: A floor exercise that trains the lower back, glutes and back muscles without equipment.
setup: Lie face down on a mat with your arms extended in front and legs straight.
Rest your forehead on the floor so your neck is neutral.
Gently brace your abs and squeeze your glutes.
execution: Lift your arms, chest and legs a few inches off the floor at the same time.
Keep your gaze down so the neck stays in line with the spine.
Hold for one to two seconds without arching hard.
mistakes: Lifting too high and compressing the lower back: lift only a few inches.
Cranking the head up: keep the gaze down at the floor.
Pain in the back: stop and choose a lighter version, such as lifting one arm and the opposite leg.
